lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign), home (new_flow), and choose_path (reorder) changes because only one test has been completed for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen) changes because the two completed tests disagreed after noise correction (+7.8% vs -6.2%).
Reordering sign_in steps was helpful overall, backed by 2 winning tests (+8.0% and +4.1%), though no clear effect was seen in the other 3 tests.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, but were too low for the round 8 sign_in reorder test.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Redesign with Pet Preview
candidates.change: Rebuild the adoption certificate screen with a two-column layout featuring a live pet mascot preview next to ownership details.
candidates.why: Adoption has the steepest conversion drop (60.9% conversion, 89s median) showing users need stronger visual connection before finalizing.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your new desktop companion is officially ready to join your workspace.

guard.reason: The redesign replaces the required official adoption stamp with a generic badge.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Selection Guidance Tip
candidates.change: Add an explicit guidance hint card on the pet selection screen explaining companion trait differences.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is severe (60.9%) with high time spent (mean 1017s), indicating decision paralysis when choosing a friend.

pick_friend.hint: Each companion brings distinct idle animations and sound effects to your desktop.

components.text: Tip: You can customize your companion's accessories anytime after setup.

guard.reason: Valid hint addition to the pick_friend screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step (60.9% conversion); guidance hint helps alleviate decision paralysis without adding new screens.

candidates.title: Generation Status Progress Tracker
candidates.change: Add a prominent animated progress indicator and tip carousel to the waiting screen while pet assets render.
candidates.why: The waiting stage takes a median 201s and mean 2336s, leading to user anxiety and drop-off during background pet generation.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Unique Desktop Pet...
waiting.body: We are assembling high-resolution animations and desktop interactions for your companion.

guard.reason: Enhances the waiting screen progress display while retaining its core function.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long waiting times during pet asset rendering with UI progress indicators.

candidates.title: Choose Path Story Scroll Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen into a full story scroll layout showcasing companion journey options.
candidates.why: Choose path drops conversion to 76.2% with a long tail mean time of 514s, showing users need clearer engagement right at entry.

choose_path.headline: Begin Your Companion Journey
choose_path.body: Choose how you want to meet your new desktop companion today.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose_path layout while continuing to offer adoption and path options.

candidates.score_note: Full redesigns on choose_path carry risk and lack strong historical success; high development cost.

candidates.title: Post Intro Desktop Readiness Confirmation
candidates.change: Add a new readiness verification screen (new_desktop_ready) after home_intro to confirm the pet is visible on screen before finishing.
candidates.why: Support mail logged 3 issues regarding pets not appearing on the desktop or users unable to launch them after onboarding.

new_desktop_ready.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
new_desktop_ready.body: Look at your screen overlay to see your new pet in action.
new_desktop_ready.hint: Use your system tray menu anytime to summon or manage pet behavior.

guard.reason: Adds a new post-intro readiness verification screen following home_intro as allowed by onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens to finish stage has mixed/negative historical evidence (-0.3% average) and adds friction.

candidates.title: Sign-In Screen Compact Social Layout
candidates.change: Reframe the sign_in screen with a compact layout explicitly assuring secure account backup and persistent sync.
candidates.why: Support mail received 8 reports of missing/reset pets after re-authenticating, showing user anxiety around account persistence.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet Companion Account
sign_in.body: Signing in ensures your pet data, traits, and progress stay safely backed up.
sign_in.hint: Your pet progress remains safe even if you re-install or switch devices.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in screen layout without adding unfair data collection or dark patterns.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence (8 reports) regarding account persistence concerns; layout adjustment is low cost.

candidates.title: Companion Personality Matching Stage
candidates.change: Insert a short personality preference quiz screen (new_pet_quiz) right before pick_friend to guide pet selection.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) and takes long (mean 1017s), pointing to user hesitation when selecting a pet.

new_pet_quiz.headline: What Kind of Companion Fits Your Vibe?
new_pet_quiz.body: Tell us your preference so we can highlight your ideal pet match.

guard.reason: Adds a valid quiz sub-flow screen before pick_friend without skipping required steps.

candidates.score_note: Targets high drop-off step but introducing a new flow step adds user friction (historical new_flow was -8.3%).

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Control Overview Copy
candidates.change: Update home_intro body and hint text with step-by-step guidance on desktop interaction, hiding, and system tray management.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets (3 emails) from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Click and drag your pet anywhere on your desktop. Right-click to access commands, hide, or chat.
home_intro.hint: Need to hide your pet during a presentation? Right-click the system tray icon anytime.

guard.reason: Updates home_intro instructional copy clearly without touching external screens.

candidates.score_note: Config/copy change directly addressing support tickets regarding post-onboarding pet control.

candidates.title: Pet Generation Completion Desktop Notification
candidates.change: Enable native desktop notification trigger options on the waiting screen when pet rendering completes.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes high mean time (2336s), so alerting users when background processing finishes prevents drop-off.

waiting.hint: Feel free to use other apps while we build your pet; we'll notify you when ready!

guard.reason: Adds notification trigger to the waiting screen during real generation wait time.

candidates.score_note: Re-engages users during long background processing (mean wait 2336s) via native notifications.

candidates.title: Sign-In Step Relocation After Upload Photos
candidates.change: Move the sign_in step to occur right after photo upload and before adoption certificate generation.
candidates.why: Lessons show sign_in step reordering produced positive lifts (+8.0% and +4.1%) when placed later in the creation flow.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Custom Companion
sign_in.body: Sign in now to link your creation to your account before final adoption.

guard.reason: Relocates sign-in step after photo upload, which is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strongest historical backing (5 tests, +2.9% mean, top wins +8.0% and +4.1%) and config-only change.
